result.summary: Found 2 issues: a restaurant name truncated in the Fastest near you section, and the pizza card missing its restaurant name and metadata while only showing a discount badge.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows a truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure the card width accommodates the full name 'Trattoria Piccolo' (or similar).

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card shows only a '-20%' badge and heart icon with no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or other metadata visible below the image (unlike the ramen card above).
issues.suggestion: Add the restaurant name, rating, delivery info, and cuisine tags below the image consistent with other restaurant cards, or ensure the card layout fully loads.
